milestone.title: Plan fragment operations — agents edit by id, never document shape

intent.outcome: Coding agents plan by issuing small mp verbs (show/add/update/remove on acceptance criteria, steps, and work packages) and reading small JSON slices — never assembling milestone documents, never replacing whole arrays via milestone update, never thinking about file layout. Every mutator returns only the changed fragment; every read can target one AC or one step by stable id. Goal 2 of Master Plan is explicit: remove formatting responsibility from agents; mp owns persistence after M92 JSON-canonical storage.

problem.description: Master Plan already enforces the pattern (goal 1) but agents still act as document editors for goal 2. Observed agent workflows during grooming and challenge sessions: (1) mp show milestone emits the full milestone (~hundreds of lines) when the agent only needed steps or one AC; (2) removing a deferred AC (e.g. after M91 supersedes M87 AC-04) has no command — agents must mp milestone update --json with a hand-built acceptance_criteria array; (3) criterion add and step add exist, but criterion update/remove and step remove do not; (4) mutators are inconsistent — criterion add returns one AC, but milestone update returns the whole milestone; (5) agents guess JSON shape when patching arrays, causing clobbered fields and validate failures. M79 added --fields for reads; M92 unifies on-disk JSON — but neither gives id-targeted fragment writes or safe deletes. Without fragment ops, agents worry about formatting; with them, agents state intent ('remove AC-04', 'update S3 action') and mp enforces coverage and schema.

in_scope: Agent use case — spec read: mp milestone ac list/show <milestone> [AC-id] and mp milestone step show <milestone> <step-id> return one fragment without full milestone load in agent context (implementation may load internally)
Agent use case — spec groom: mp milestone ac update/remove; challenge finding resolves by removing deferred AC without rebuilding array
Agent use case — decompose: mp milestone step remove for discarded steps; mp milestone wp remove for empty/superseded WPs
Agent use case — execution: mp list steps --milestone <id> --fields projection documented; step show returns tests/done_when/covers_ac for one step
Extend --fields: acceptance_criteria[AC-03] and steps[S4] id selectors (in addition to index [])
mp milestone ac add (alias/wrapper of criterion add), ac update (description, verification), ac remove
mp milestone step remove <milestone> <step-id> with depends_on_steps and coverage guards
mp milestone wp remove <milestone> <wp-id> when no steps reference the WP
Normalize mutator stdout contract across ac/step/wp add/update/remove (fragment only)
mp milestone update guard: reject acceptance_criteria and steps in --json unless --replace-arrays
Update AGENTS.md, master-planner skill, MP-COMMANDS.md, AGENT-READINESS with fragment-first recipes and anti-patterns (no array rebuild)
Integration tests per use case; make test-scenarios if CLI help text changes
out_of_scope: JSON Patch / RFC 6902 generic patch endpoint
Fragment ops on ideas/backlog/tracks (separate artifact commands)
raul new subcommands (raul continues to shell to mp)
Changing milestone or step id assignment scheme
Bulk fragment ops across milestones (mp reviews finding resolve --all pattern is separate)

design_decisions.choice: Strict guard: mp milestone update --json rejects acceptance_criteria and steps keys by default
design_decisions.rationale: Goal 2 — agents must not rebuild document arrays. Everyday planning uses fragment commands (ac/step/wp add|update|remove). Hard error prevents accidental clobber; no soft deprecation.

design_decisions.choice: Escape hatch: --replace-arrays on milestone update allows whole-array replacement for migration scripts and maintainer tools only
design_decisions.rationale: M82/M92 rebaseline and one-off repairs need bulk array writes. Flag is explicit and auditable; agents and skills must not use it in normal grooming/execute flows.

findings.description: drift: 3 pre-existing test failures in tests/fixtures/projects/hybrid-work (hybrid_session_path::hybrid_next_returns_session_step_when_tracks_done, scenarios_runner::run_implemented_scenarios p3.1-hybrid-work-next-track, validate_readiness::validate_hybrid_work_fixture). Reproducible on clean tree before M93 changes via 'git stash -u && cargo test -p mp --test scenarios_runner' (returns same 'No actionable steps found' for the BF-02 expected output). Out of scope for fragment ops — failing flow is mp next returning a track bugfix from a hybrid session, which does not touch ac/step/wp fields. Full cargo test -p mp totals 544 passed, 3 failed; all 3 failures are this same root cause. Recommend a separate track bugfix (hybrid-session + fixture alignment).
